method.evidence_mode: deterministic ruleset predicates plus exact static hand enumeration
method.ruleset_score_mode: straight 42; doubles-as-trump id 7; doubles-suit no-trump variant id 8 excluded; standard no-trump id 9
method.statistical_test: exact enumeration; no confidence interval needed for full-population hand counts
method.oracle_regret_slice: not available in this worktree; existing v0 artifacts expose only a broad declaration group and no isolated no-trump/doubles rows

doubles_trump_candidate_4plus.interpretation: Four-plus doubles are rare enough to be a candidate gate, not a strategy verdict.

dt_candidate_missing_6_6.interpretation: Many four-plus-double hands lack the top double, so double count alone is insufficient.

dt_candidate_missing_top_double.interpretation: A stricter high-double gate still filters a large share of doubles-trump candidates.

dt_candidate_off_count_liability.interpretation: Off-count exposure remains common among candidate doubles-trump hands.

dt_candidate_has_dual_top_6_5.interpretation: 6-5 dual-top protection is measurable but not common enough to be assumed.

no_trump_support_proxy.interpretation: Static proxy for no-trump support doubles; needs oracle rollout for strategy status.

regime_switch_proxy_nt_over_dt.interpretation: Candidate same-hand regime-switch bucket: 4+ doubles, weak high-double coverage, and no-trump support proxy.

claim_ledger_impact: schema-shaped artifact only; no central claim-ledger rewrite
